Apple rarely introduces new screen sizes for the iPhone, but the iPhone Ultra debuting this fall will introduce two screen shapes and sizes never before used on an iPhone. Here's what you can expect.

iPhone Ultra will introduce two brand-new screen shapes and sizes

For years, the screen size options offered by Apple's iPhone lineup have remained largely the same.

Although there have been minor changes, recent iPhones have mainly come in two sizes: a 6.1- to 6.3-inch model, and a larger 6.7- to 6.9-inch version.

However, this year's iPhone Ultra will bring two entirely new iPhone screen sizes that are very different from the past.

The rumored screen sizes for the iPhone Ultra include:

  • Outer screen around 5.3 inches
  • Inner screen around 7.6 inches

Both options mark a significant departure from recent iPhone screens.

The outer screen will be much smaller than in the past, while the inner screen will be even larger than the iPhone 17 Pro Max.

The iPhone Ultra will be shorter than other modern iPhones, but at the same time wider. Compared with previous iPhones, this device may offer a unique look and feel.

How will iOS and apps adapt to the new screen shape and size? We'll have to wait until September to find out.

But based on what we've already seen in the iOS 27 beta, Apple is now prioritizing iPhone app support for landscape mode. Third-party apps are expected to follow suit to take full advantage of that larger, iPad mini-like inner screen.

What do you think of the rumored iPhone Ultra design? Feel free to share in the comments section.
